high_level_description: This image depicts a modern living room with a minimalist and elegant design. The room features a large sectional sofa with a dark brown wooden frame and gray cushions. The sofa is adorned with two patterned throw pillows, adding a touch of color and texture to the otherwise neutral palette. In front of the sofa, there is a matching coffee table with a dark finish, which has a small sign on it that reads "DOUCEUR FURNITURE." To the left of the sofa, there is an armchair with a similar dark brown wooden frame and gray cushion, complementing the overall aesthetic of the room.
